TCGA-NSCLC: The overall differentiation and maturity of cells within the tissue.
The spatial distribution and extent of tissue structures.
The clarity of tissue boundaries and their demarcation from surrounding structures.
Morphological characteristics of cell nuclei and cytoplasm, including size, shape, and staining.
The presence of cellular proliferation or active division within the tissue.
Areas of degeneration, necrosis, or structural damage within the tissue.
The arrangement of cells within the tissue and their overall growth patterns.
The distribution of cells in relation to blood vessels or lymphatic structures.
